text:
Alex (AE): quick question — procurement on Acme wants to buy via AWS Marketplace but insist those $ go against the Dedicated commit. can we allow marketplace purchases to offset a Reserved commit?
Maria (Deals): short answer: not by default. marketplace SKUs flow through the marketplace billing path, different ledger. but we can request a deal-desk exception.
Alex (AE): ok — procurement says they won't sign a corporate PO if marketplace can't count. they're saying AWS will only provide a consolidated invoice.
Devon (Finance): FYI finance view: marketplace revenue recognition and grossing-up rules mean we need an approved offset policy + reconciliation cadence and a credit memo process.
SalesOpsBot: created ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SD-4928 for marketplace-offset exception (assign: Maria).
Maria (Deals): action items I propose: 1) get procurement legal confirmation that marketplace invoice equals committed spend line items, 2) deal desk approval for offsetting marketplace charges for this customer only, 3) monthly reconciliation statement.
Raj (PSC): technical confirm — marketplace SKU names differ from our internal ratecard. we need an SKU mapping table so billing can match tokens/usage to committed units.
Alex (AE): can we ship a SKU map quickly? customer is starting POC next week.
Emily (Legal): legal needs to add a short addendum: "Marketplace purchases will be eligible for offset against the committed spend subject to monthly reconciliation and mutually agreed SKU mapping" — also need indemnity/tax language if reseller involved.
Devon (Finance): sample reconciliation procedure (draft):
```
- Each month AWS provides consolidated invoice to customer.
- Customer provides usage detail; Sales Ops maps marketplace SKUs => Redwood internal SKU ID.
- Finance issues credit memo against committed invoice if marketplace usage applies.
- Any delta disputed within 30 days; unresolved amounts applied to next month's reconciliation.
```
Maria (Deals): sounds reasonable. two blockers: deal desk needs to approve because it's a special term, and accounting needs the SKU map + an evidence sample (one month of AWS invoice lines).
Alex (AE): procurement is willing to share last 3 months of marketplace invoices as proof. I can request that now.
Raj (PSC): I'll prepare a SKU mapping template — small CSV with columns: marketplace_sku, internal_sku, unit_type, token_equiv. ETA EOD.
Devon (Finance): also need a GL flow: where do credit memos hit revenue vs contra-revenue. I'll draft with accounting and share by tomorrow.
SalesOpsBot: @Maria (Deals) reminder: SD-4928 due in 48h for deal desk review.
Maria (Deals): I'll submit to Deal Desk with supporting docs (invoice sample + SKU map + proposed legal addendum).
Emily (Legal): if deal desk approves, Legal will produce the addendum and short SOW clause. plan for 2 business days for final doc.
Alex (AE): great. longshot Q: any reason we can't do a one-off discount code for marketplace purchases to mimic offset instead of credit memos? simpler?
Devon (Finance): not ideal — discount codes would impact marketplace reporting and may be restricted by marketplace terms. prefer reconciliation + credit memos for audit trail.
Maria (Deals): agreed. consolidate: Alex to get invoices; Raj to send SKU map; Maria will file SD-4928 + Deal Desk package; Devon + Emily will draft finance/legal language.
Alex (AE): done — I asked procurement to upload invoices (sharing link to ticket). will update when available. :thumbsup:
Raj (PSC): posting SKU map template: https://drive.redwood.com/sales/sd-4928-sku-map.csv
Devon (Finance): flagged to accounting team. I'll loop in @Olivia (Accounting) on the ticket.
Emily (Legal): cc: I'll review once package is up.
Maria (Deals): thanks team — if deal desk ok, we should capture this as a policy precedent (template addendum) for future Marketplace-offset asks.
Alex (AE): agreed — makes future closes faster.
SalesOpsBot: SD-4928 status: "Awaiting docs".
Alex (AE): uploading invoices now.
Maria (Deals): ping when uploaded and I'll push the deal desk request.
Alex (AE): uploaded — link in SD-4928.
Maria (Deals): pushing now. will update thread when decision made.
Devon (Finance): note for future: if offsets become common we should discuss adding a Marketplace Offset clause to standard enterprise agreements.
Emily (Legal): agreed. also check reseller agreements for any conflicts.
Alex (AE): thanks all, will wait for deal desk note.
Maria (Deals): Deal Desk response: approved as one-off contingent on (1) invoice sample match, (2) SKU map, (3) signed addendum. next steps: finalize addendum.
Alex (AE): perfect, pushing to procurement for signature.
Maria (Deals): closing the loop: Deal Desk conditioned approval logged in SD-4928. we'll keep this as a redwood precedent doc once executed. :white_check_mark:
